summary: 10.0.34.19 Enterprise Release - Item Master Import Desktop Parity & Bulk Upsert Fix (POST /api/master/items/bulk integration, checkItemExists verification, eliminating duplicate key 500 errors)
highlights: 1. Item Master Import Desktop Parity: Fully aligned Web's Item Master import with Desktop's ItemSpreadsheetService.java by routing imports through POST /api/master/items/bulk (MasterDataService.saveItems). This performs atomic server-side find-or-create on the database entity, eliminating PostgreSQL unique constraint collisions on item_master(item_code).

2. Proactive checkItemExists Integration: Added server-level exists verification via /api/master/items/exists before import execution, ensuring accurate detection of existing items regardless of client caching or view permissions.
3. MasterService.bulkSaveItems API Method: Exposed bulkSaveItems in MasterService.js to provide standard, reliable bulk upsert capabilities identical to desktop's MasterApiClient.saveItems.

4. Zero-Friction Conflict Resolution: Item imports now update existing records without requiring rowVersion locks or failing on opening stock discrepancies, while properly creating new items with opening stock.
